connections.label: 'UAP Gerb' (Sam)
connections.note: Published 13 December 2025; 141,122 views; nearly three hours.

desc: A near-three-hour investigation published 13 December 2025 arguing that the NRO is far more deeply embedded in the legacy effort than its public profile suggests. Its specific, falsifiable propositions: that the NRO and its Sentient artificial-intelligence program supplied IMINT and SIGINT from both tasked and untasked overhead collection platforms to an unacknowledged special access program called Immaculate Constellation established in 2017; that the NRO provides direct mission support to crash-retrieval teams; that in the 21st century the NRO spearheaded a crash retrieval team stationed out of the Nevada Test and Training Range; that senior gatekeepers can be identified by analysing the offices controlling NRO acquisitions, namely USD(A&S) and DDNI(AT&F); that curious relationships exist between alleged legacy personnel and MITRE, CIA Directorate of Science and Technology, CIA Office of Global Access, the NRO and the Executive branch; and that the NRO showed egregious misappropriation of funds through carry-over appropriations in the mid-1990s. The Sentient-to-Immaculate-Constellation link is the most consequential claim: it supplies a concrete collection pipeline for the programme Shellenberger put into the congressional record thirteen months earlier. Chapters: HISTORY OF THE NRO (09:05), IMMACULATE CONSTELLATION / SENTIENT (25:25), NRO RETRIEVAL TEAMS (1:04:26), NRO, OGA, OUSDAT & GATEKEEPERS (2:01:18), CONCLUSION (2:51:28). 141,122 views.
